items.title: Financial Services ML — New York's Largest ML Market
items.description: New York's financial services sector — investment banks, commercial banks, hedge funds, asset managers, insurance companies, and FinTech — is the US's most ML-active industry segment. Fraud detection: real-time ML scoring transactions, card-not-present fraud, account takeover attempts, and synthetic identity fraud — trained on New York-specific transaction patterns. Credit risk scoring: ML models for commercial and consumer credit decision support with FCRA adverse action reason code integration (SHAP-based), ECOA disparate impact testing, and SR 26-2 model validation documentation for OCC-regulated institutions. Market risk and portfolio analytics: ML models for VaR estimation, portfolio stress testing, and factor exposure analysis. Anti-money laundering: ML-based transaction monitoring augmenting rules-based systems. *All New York financial services ML models delivered with SR 26-2 aligned validation documentation as standard for banking clients.* Cost: $50,000–$145,000 | Timeline: 12–26 weeks.
items.label: Financial Services
